ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 0.35:1 ratio of high-intensity (white) pixels to low-intensity (black) pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant high-intensity (white) contiguous region on the distal right lobe with embedded low-intensity spots. Left lobe features a smaller, fragmented high-intensity region characterized by a high density of small circular white points on a black background. Central and basal regions are uniformly low-intensity (black).

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression with a calculated angle of approximately 42 degrees; depth extends approximately 120 pixels from the average trailing edge baseline.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous irregular trailing edge. Left lobe displays high-frequency, low-amplitude serrations (fine-toothed). Right lobe displays lower-frequency, high-amplitude serrations with distinct jagged peaks and deeper valleys.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Sigmoidal curve fitting both lobes; exhibiting a convex sweep starting from the median notch and transitioning to a concave trajectory toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple circular pixel clusters detected. Left lobe contains numerous small, high-intensity rings on black background. Right lobe features larger, low-intensity rings and spots within the high-intensity white region.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Detection of four distinct, parallel, near-vertical low-intensity linear marks (rake marks) located on the mid-distal region of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Visible high-relief, irregular brownish-grey pixel clusters at the extreme distal tips of both lobes (epibiotic colonization). Significant parallel linear scarring on the right lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique 'islet' pattern on the far right lobe where a dark circular pixel cluster is completely isolated within a high-intensity white field, adjacent to the trailing edge.
